attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own post, judging the Deep Research Fediverse report Newton shared. He is not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: The proposition keeps the scope (the Fediverse example report) and the emphatic 'at all'. It is a firm, unhedged judgment about an existing report, so treating it as an observation is reasonable.

contract.note: He named no measure. The plain reading (weak, repetitive sources and poor gathering of relevant information) matches his own complaints about citations and is ordinary. The support and contradiction conditions are fair, but the result depends on how 'at all' is weighed.

evidence.note: Independent audit of the same report, published 2025-03-03, before the evaluation date. It finds the report's main source had major factual problems that carried into the output.
The same audit identifies relevant sources the report missed, such as Sub.club. That is a real research gap.
The same auditor says the report gets a lot right, is well structured, finds relevant obscure information and covers most key points. That cuts against 'not well-researched at all'.

reviews.rationale: The only independent review backs part of the claim: the report leans heavily on a mediocre Twipe source, repeats its factual errors and misses relevant sources. But the same reviewer credits it with much correct information, relevant and even obscure examples, and coverage of most key points. So 'not well-researched at all' is overstated. Neither the support condition (few real strengths) nor the contradiction condition (only minor weaknesses) is fully met.
